page.content:
Res publica of consuls, Senate, and assemblies, c. 509–27 BCE.

How Roman Republic connects

  • Topic: Ancient Rome — The Republic is Rome's classical political form.
  • Faction: Roman Empire — The Republic preceded and was transformed into the Empire.
  • Event: Punic Wars — The Republic became a Mediterranean empire through the Punic Wars.
  • Faction: Roman Senate — The Senate was the steering council of the Republic.
  • Faction: Roman legion — The manipular legion was the Republic's army.

What is Roman Republic?

The Roman Republic replaced the kings with annual magistrates and senatorial authority. It conquered Italy and the Mediterranean, then broke under civil war into the principate.

Key threads lead to Ancient Rome, Roman Empire, Punic Wars, Roman Senate and Roman legion.
